It just felt a little uncomfortable and tight at first. I chose dark pink elastics.
There weren't many colors to choose from, but they had both dark and light shades.
I've had braces for about a month and a half now. My teeth are slowly moving into alignment, and I feel much more confident when I smile. I really love it!
